metadata.description: House of Vibe Claude Code tools for builders.

plugins.name: token-eater
plugins.description: Spend expiring AI credits on isolated, verified code cleanup that opens a draft pull request and never merges.

rows: ⚡ **Use it or lose it** · your AI credits expire monthly; this spends the leftovers
🧹 **Safe cleanup** · works in an isolated copy, verifies + reviews its own changes
🛡️ **You stay in control** · opens a draft PR, never merges without you
card.run: Then run `/token-eater` on your messiest repo

plugins.name: pro-gate
plugins.description: Run a final pull request review using the Pro model selected by your ChatGPT account, with guided runtime setup and no automatic merge.

rows: ⚡ **The deepest review, last** · your ChatGPT Pro model reads the whole PR before merge
🔍 **Finds what earlier tiers missed** · logic, security, integrity, race conditions
🛡️ **You stay in control** · findings and a verdict, never an auto-merge
card.run: Then run `/pro-gate` on your next PR

plugins.name: skill-tuner
plugins.description: Tell whether a change to an agent-consumed document actually worked. /skill-tuner:tune probes a SKILL.md, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, fixes what three independent skeptics confirm, and proves the description still routes. Paired comparison with a confidence interval, content-hashed provenance with drift detection, and it reads skill-creator benchmark output.

rows: ⚡ **Did that skill edit actually work?** · a before/after count on one document is not evidence
🔬 **Three skeptics, then a verdict** · confirmed defects fixed, and a paired comparison with a real confidence interval
🛡️ **You stay in control** · reports land as inputs to your decision; a reworded description ships only at routing parity
card.run: Then run `/skill-tuner:tune` on your most-used SKILL.md

plugins.name: wsl-cdp
plugins.description: Drive your real, logged-in Windows browser (Chrome, Edge, or Brave) from Claude Code inside WSL2 over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Read authenticated dashboards, take real screenshots, and run a guided one-time setup; sends native-Windows users to the official extension instead.

card.tagline: Claude Code plugin · WSL2 only · 2-min setup · auto-updates
rows: ⚡ **Your real browser, driven from WSL2** · authenticated dashboards, real screenshots, sessions that survive reboots
🌉 **Bridges the VM boundary** · native messaging cannot cross it; wsl-cdp connects Claude Code to Chrome, Edge, or Brave over CDP
🛡️ **Sessions, never passwords** · a dedicated agent profile with browser sign-in disabled; log it into only what agents should touch
card.run: Then run `/wsl-cdp:setup` once and point your agent at a real dashboard

plugins.name: memory-dream
plugins.description: The sleep cycle for Claude Code's auto-memory. /memory-dream:dream runs an operator-gated consolidation pass: deterministic triage finds superseded, stale, and oversized notes, a zero-tool subagent drafts the fixes it cannot apply, and you approve each change by hand before anything is written. /memory-dream:eval measures whether recall actually improved. Also a standalone stdlib-only CLI; it never merges, deletes, or compresses a note on its own.

rows: ⚡ **Auto-memory rots** · notes go stale, supersede each other, and route Claude to old answers
🧠 **The missing sleep cycle** · deterministic triage, sandboxed drafting, and a recall eval that proves the pass helped
🛡️ **You stay in control** · every change is a diff you approve by hand; nothing merges or deletes on its own
card.run: Then run `/memory-dream:dream` on your busiest project

plugins.name: design-rails
plugins.description: Guardrails that keep AI agents on your design system. Posture-check whether a real, agent-wired, CI-enforced design system exists, derive a Google-spec DESIGN.md from the code you already ship, put open taste decisions on visual pages for the human to pick, and ratchet drift budgets that only move down. Read-only on application source — it authors under design/ and never edits your code.

rows: ⚡ **Agents drift off your design system** · every PR nudges colors, spacing, and components a little further apart
📐 **Rails, not vibes** · a DESIGN.md derived from the code you ship, taste calls on visual pages, drift budgets that only move down
🛡️ **Read-only on your source** · it authors under design/ and never edits your application code
card.run: Then ask your agent to posture-check your design system with `/design-rails`

plugins.name: harness-vet
plugins.description: Adoption gate for external agent tooling. /harness-vet deep-dives a skill, plugin, MCP server, repo, or paper against YOUR harness: a candidate can be skip globally and adopt in one project, with artifact safety judged once and utility, reachable incumbents and context cost judged per target — claims verified by running them, placement and activation verified on the live host, and an audit dividend that often outvalues the verdict.

rows: 🚦 **Before you install that skill** · the default answer is skip, and the receipts say why
🎯 **Right skill, wrong scope** · useless clutter globally can be the perfect fit in one project — v0.2 judges each target on its own
💰 **The audit dividend** · even a rejected candidate pays — vetting it surfaces drift in your own harness
card.run: Then run `/harness-vet <url> for <project-path>` on the next thing your feed says you need

plugins.name: rent-check
plugins.description: Every always-loaded line pays rent or gets cut. /rent-check audits CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules dirs and the always-loaded surface around them: load-class costing, enforcement-backing analysis (which rules are just words), reality drift against the live repo, and evidence-tiered verdicts with folklore labeled as folklore — report-first, verified draft diffs, never auto-applied.

rows: ⚡ **Your CLAUDE.md bills you every turn** · most context files carry lines that earn nothing
🔬 **Evidence-tiered verdicts, folklore labeled** · KEEP/FIX/PROMOTE/DEMOTE/MERGE/CUT with citations — and which of your rules are just words
🛡️ **Report-first, edit-never** · verified draft diffs land as inputs to your decision; a mandatory counter-finding keeps it honest
card.run: Then run `/rent-check` in your busiest repo

plugins.name: papercut
plugins.description: Friction your agents route around silently, captured automatically and mined into ranked, verified fixes. A PostToolUseFailure hook logs every hard tool failure; a stdlib-only CLI ranks by distinct sessions hit, folds duplicates into causal families, and refuses to call a fix verified on silence alone.

rows: 🩹 **Friction your agents route around silently, captured automatically** · every hard tool failure logged, zero effort
📊 **Ranked by distinct sessions hit** · repetition drives priority; duplicate spellings fold into one causal family
🔬 **Fixes get verified, not declared** · silence only counts once enough live traffic has passed to make it meaningful
card.run: Then let the hook collect for a few days and run `/papercut`

plugins.name: product-video
plugins.description: Agent-native product walkthrough videos. Capture a real authenticated browser tour over CDP at a forced 16:9 geometry so a tall operator window cannot letterbox the recording, overlay a real cursor driven by telemetry that carries no URLs, DOM text, or account data, compose in Remotion, and render a digest-bound H.264 you can verify frame by frame.

rows: 🎬 **A real browser tour, not a slideshow** · authenticated capture over CDP, forced 16:9 so window shape never letterboxes the frame
🖋️ **A cursor that actually moves** · eased glide paths and click ripples from safe telemetry — no URLs, DOM text, or account data recorded
🔎 **Renders you can prove** · digest-bound provenance plus OCR-verified caption and frame evidence at every route and click
card.run: Then drop a scenario in and run `pnpm narrated:capture --help`

plugins.name: sign-it
plugins.description: Agent-native PDF signing: type /sign-it with a document and get <file>-signed.pdf back; Claude never starts it on its own. Finds the signature line in form fields, the text layer (typed or drawn rules, captions under the rule), or scanned pages, stamps your stored signature and today's date, previews the result, and never stamps over an existing signature. Converts Word documents, opens owner-password forms, fails closed when the line is missing or ambiguous, and can add a PAdES seal. Your own signature only, never a counterparty's.

rows: ✍️ **Type /sign-it** · only you start it; the first run asks in plain words: draw your signature in the browser or on your phone, or use a photo
🛑 **Never over a signature, never a draft, never a guess** · an already-signed line or a DRAFT / Proposed Revision marker stops it and asks; two equal lines stop it too
📄 **PDFs, Word files, forms, scans** · AcroForm fields, typed or drawn rules and captions, .docx via LibreOffice or Word, owner-password forms, OCR for scans
card.run: Then type `/sign-it` with a document; the first run sets up your signature and details

plugins.name: harness-optimizer
plugins.description: Investigate recurring Claude Code setup problems across six evidence lanes, select up to three repair families, and independently challenge the diagnosis, changes and outcome. Explicitly invoked, with existing permissions and specialist consent preserved. Attempt limits are not spending caps.

card.tagline: Claude Code plugin: investigate recurring setup problems before changing things
rows: **Six areas, one investigation**: friction, memory, instructions, context, permissions and tooling
**Separate investigators and reviewers**: challenge the diagnosis, changes and reported outcome for up to three repair families
**Only when you invoke it**: existing approvals still apply; missing evidence stays visible and attempt limits are not spending caps
card.run: Run `/harness-optimizer:harness-optimizer` in the project you want to investigate

plugins.name: hov-stack
plugins.description: The skill pack from the hov-stack Claude Code harness, installable on its own as one plugin.

rows: ⚡ **45 skills in one install** · design review, writing, research, verification and agent workflows
🎨 **Review and polish, not just generate** · interface, accessibility, color, layout and writing passes that catch what you would miss
🛡️ **Skills, not a takeover** · installing it changes no settings or hooks; /hov-setup runs only when typed and asks before each change; the full harness is a separate ./setup
card.run: Then run `/hov-stack:interface-review` on your next UI change
